sources.quote: The August 2024 Calgary storm caused insured losses of roughly $2.8 to $3.25 billion across more than 130,000 claims, over half of them auto
sources.title: August hailstorm in Calgary results in nearly $2.8 billion in insured damage
sources.evidence: A record-breaking hailstorm that hit the Calgary area in early August resulted in nearly $2.8 billion in insured losses, according to initial estimates from Catastrophe Indices and Quantification Inc. (CatIQ). Alberta's insurers have been working to process over 130,000 claims from the hailstorm. Over half of those claims – about 70,000 of them – were for damage to vehicles. The damage estimates have been updated since initial reporting, with total insured losses now estimated to be $3.25 billion.

sources.quote: Roofing is not a compulsory trade and there is no provincial roofing licence
sources.title: Roofer - Skilled Trades Ontario
sources.evidence: Because this trade is non-compulsory, this certificate does not have to be renewed, and the information of individuals practicing this trade will not appear on the Skilled Trades Ontario Public Register. Non-compulsory trades do not require you to be a registered apprentice or certified journeyperson to legally work in the trade.

sources.quote: WSIB coverage is compulsory for roofing contractors, including sole proprietors
sources.title: Expanded compulsory coverage in the construction industry | WSIB
sources.evidence: Under current legislation, independent operators, sole proprietors, some partners in a partnership and some executive officers who work in construction must have WSIB coverage. Roofing is classified within the construction industry's Class G, with roofing contractors having a specific NAICS code (238160). A clearance is a unique number issued by the WSIB to registered businesses, which shows that a business, contractor or subcontractor is registered and up-to-date.

sources.quote: A contract signed at the home is a direct agreement carrying a 10 day cooling off right
sources.title: Your rights when signing or cancelling a contract
sources.evidence: You always have a cooling-off period when you sign a contract in your home. You can cancel the contract for any reason within 10 days of receiving a written copy of the agreement. A direct agreement is a consumer agreement that is negotiated or concluded in person, at a place other than a place of business. Almost all goods and services that are sold in a consumer's home require a direct agreement. This includes contracts for water heaters, home renovations and lawn maintenance services.

sources.quote: you need a Prepaid Contracting licence and financial security from Service Alberta
sources.title: Prepaid contracting licence | Alberta.ca
sources.evidence: A prepaid contracting business solicits, negotiates or concludes prepaid contracts in person at any place other than the sellers' place of business and accepts money before all the work is done or the services are provided. Prepaid contractors must be licensed by Service Alberta and post a security. No licence may be issued or renewed unless the applicant submits to the Director a security that is in a form and in an amount approved by the Director.

sources.quote: BC's Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act gives the same 10 day right
sources.title: Door to door sales - Consumer Protection BC
sources.evidence: Once you receive a copy of the contract, you have 10 days to cancel for any reason. You must give written notice of cancellation to the seller within that 10-day period. A consumer may cancel a direct sales contract by giving notice of cancellation to the supplier not later than 10 days after the date that the consumer receives a copy of the contract.

sources.quote: An RBQ contractor licence is mandatory and the number must appear on all advertising, including your website and trucks
sources.title: Displaying your licence - Régie du bâtiment du Québec - RBQ
sources.evidence: Contractors that hold a licence in good standing must display at all times their licence number on all of their identification and promotion supports. This includes the company's vehicle, in the company's advertisements or in its website or page. You must indicate your RBQ licence number on your estimates, bids, contracts, account statements and invoices.

sources.quote: implied consent runs two years from a purchase and six months from a quote request
sources.title: From Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) Guidance on Implied Consent | CRTC
sources.evidence: Under CASL, implied consent through an existing business relationship may be valid for up to 2 years—or just 6 months in the case of inquiries or applications. Consent must be acquired within the two-year period immediately before the day on which the message was sent, or within the six-month period immediately before the day on which the message was sent in the case of an inquiry.

sources.quote: which private parties have been able to seek leave to sue over since June 2025
sources.title: Competition Bureau issues a revised bulletin on private access to the Competition Tribunal - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: On June 20, 2025, the Competition Bureau published a revised information bulletin on private access to the Competition Tribunal following recent changes to the Competition Act that expanded access. These changes further expand private access to the Tribunal including by allowing applications related to deceptive marketing and by easing the legal test used to determine which applications can proceed. Starting June 20, 2025, people can directly apply for permission to file an application against businesses under the deceptive marketing practices provisions of the Act.

sources.quote: Adjusting is regulated by bodies such as FSRA in Ontario
sources.publisher: Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA)
sources.title: Apply for a new insurance adjuster licence | Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario
sources.evidence: If you want to be an independent or public insurance adjuster in Ontario, you must apply for a licence with the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA). Public adjusters and independent adjusters need to be licensed by FSRA. Adjusters must renew their licence with FSRA every year on June 30.

sources.title: What is an average marketing budget for a small business?
sources.evidence: A common rule of thumb is that B2B companies should spend between 2 and 5% of their revenue on marketing. For B2C companies, the proportion is often higher—between 5 and 10%.

flags.quote: WSIB coverage is compulsory for roofing contractors, including sole proprietors
flags.issue: Incomplete: WSIB says independent operators and sole proprietors in construction are exempt from compulsory coverage if the business is engaged exclusively in exempt home renovation work, meaning repairs or renovations on an existing private residence where they are hired and paid directly by the homeowner or occupant. A roofer who only does homeowner-hired re-roofs is therefore not required to carry coverage for themselves (employees must still be covered).
